title: Load supported HumbleSudoku from local export first
summary: Make the supported-app HumbleSudoku action behave like a localhost/developer workflow by loading the adjacent local HumbleSudoku export first and generating the bundle through the allowlisted HumbleSudoku export script when the file is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the supported HumbleSudoku app in the native macOS workspace attempts to load `/Users/janpokorny/Coding/personal/apps/HumbleSudoku/.humble/HumbleSudoku.humblebundle` before falling back to any remote URL behavior.

If the configured HumbleSudoku local bundle is missing, HumbleStudio runs the allowlisted HumbleSudoku `Scripts/generate_humble_studio_config.py --bundle` export command and then imports the generated bundle.
The web fallback bridge preserves supported-app source context for native local imports instead of reducing the session to an anonymous local file.
The remote URL path remains available for supported apps without a local export resolver.
Status, recovery messaging, docs, and Top 10 runway record the local-first HumbleSudoku integration without claiming general edit/write-back support.

evidence.note: The configured HumbleSudoku local bundle and allowlisted export script both exist; the missing-file generation path was not forced because that would mutate the adjacent HumbleSudoku repo artifact.
The web fallback bridge changes for native supported-app source context are syntactically valid.
The string catalog stayed valid after adding local supported-app status and recovery messages.
The repo status JSON stayed valid after recording the local-first HumbleSudoku integration.
The HS-0091 ticket JSON stayed valid before schema validation.
The repo-native HS ticket surface validated successfully with 89 tickets.
The local repo contract still validates against the shared HumbleControl-owned standard.
The static web fallback integrity check stayed green after the native source-context bridge change.
Workflow-only local checks passed for tickets, contract, script compilation, web fallback, and diff hygiene.
The native macOS workspace builds after adding local supported-app loading.
The repo-documented native CI path completed a build-only macOS sanity pass for HS-0091.
After the commit, strict doctor reported the expected active topic-branch freshness gate at 97% with 3 issue(s) and 0 dirty path(s).

trigger.source_ref: Jan said localhost clicks on HumbleSudoku should show HumbleSudoku and create missing export files automatically, because the current HumbleStudio/HumbleControl connection is still weak.

agent_notes: This is a local-first supported-app load path, not a generic arbitrary command runner.
Only HumbleSudoku has an allowlisted local export resolver in this slice; MyVltavaRun and HumbleControl still use the existing remote URL path until they get their own verified local contracts.
The web fallback can preserve source context from the native bridge, but static browser JavaScript still cannot safely generate local files by itself.
Native-ci regenerated `HumbleStudio.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`; keep it in the slice so the checked-in project matches the repo-documented build path.
